CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Industrial manufacture of inorganic chemicals ● Ammonia - The Haber Process. (ra.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1.? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols 3.2 Alkanoic acid 3.3 Detergents 3.4 Polymers Page 12 of 40 1 STRAND 1..

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and extraction of metals ● Occurrence of carbon (allotropes of carbon-dia.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
